resolution.rejection_description: Rejected because exactly one candidate came back anomalous, with part of the biometrics matching and part not, at a match score above the false-positive threshold, with no face match and no confirmed true duplicate.
resolution.synthesis: The resident applied for a fresh enrolment, which requires their biometrics to be globally unique. A single high-scoring partial match could be neither cleared as a false positive nor confirmed as a duplicate, so uniqueness was never established and the packet was rejected while the matched record holding an Aadhaar was suspended. A fresh packet with a complete, good-quality capture of every modality is needed to resolve that match.
